about.registryInfo: The equity owner and issuing entity for this property is Investis d.o.o., a company incorporated in Slovenia. The property carried a mortgage originally of 480,000 euro, serviced from property cash flows, giving a pre tokenization capital structure of roughly sixty three and a half percent common equity against thirty six and a half percent senior debt. Company registration number and registered address were not supplied. Property records are held in the Blocksquare property registry at 0x05325C1Ab1440df7214dB38F676F95999729267B on Ethereum.
